text.description_html:
Acorn AH4BQ, 3" Offset HL Cabinet Hinge

This is a traditional "H-L" style cabinet hinge. It mounts easily, using a few screws. The smooth iron finish is typical of early American styling, with a flat black appearance which simulates the hardware as it may have looked originally if it was forged a century ago. The 3" Offset Smooth Iron H-L Cabinet Hinge is for where the door face sits 3/8" out from the door frame.

Specifications of the Smooth Iron H-L Cabinet Hinges:

  • Finish: Smooth Black Iron
  • Height: 3"
  • Width: 1-11/16"
  • 3/8" Offset Hinge -- Door face sits 3/8" out from the door frame.

Sold as a pair (2-hinges)
